body: aida-host PR #7 (SIGINT/SIGQUIT restore, BUG-84) is merged and live. Rebase /home/joe/ai/aida-host-wip on origin/main and drop the sig_restore part of the WIP. Non-blocking follow-ups from the review, for your next PR: warn on stderr when env lacks --default-signal, and move the probe after the passthrough exec paths (--version/--help/non-build subcommands) to save 2 forks per call. Next PR: stale-ticket identity, cargo kill exact match/confirm/WRAPPER guard, veryhigh, R74 and the acq sweep.
